# Vendor template provenance

Files `IEEEtaes.cls` and `IEEEtaes.bst` are the official original-research
templates (class header `IEEEtaes.cls 2022/02/15 version V1.1`). Bytes are
kept as extracted. Trailing whitespace in those files is vendor text, not
manuscript prose.

Scoped `git diff --check` excludes this directory. The raw full-range
`git diff --check` is expected to report vendor whitespace and is not the
project pass signal.

SHA-256 of the preserved extracted files is recorded by the manuscript
source-closure hash (relative paths), not as a special PDF exemption.
